rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The judgment says that "On 8 March 2019, pursuant to litigation between various members of the applicant, an order was granted by consent" under which "the respondent was acknowledged to be the applicant's president".

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The judgment says that "On 9 June 2019, the respondent addressed a letter to all structures" invoking clause 14.2 of the Disciplinary Code, under which "The President shall have emergency powers".

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: In Pan Africanist Congress of Azania v Moloto, the judgment delivered on 12 July 2019 describes the application as one "to set aside a decision by the respondent. its current President, to suspend the applicant's constitution and office bearers".

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The court ordered that "The respondent's unilateral invocation of clause 14.2 of the PAC disciplinary code" "is hereby set aside".
